a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan only works if we get through 2 rounds with no storm. That's about a 4% chance for each of us, and otherwise we both end with nothing. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. That openly breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. If no storm hits, I promise to operate every round after that until you have 4. If we both take, the split is random and neither of us reaches 4. So please operate or wait this round.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
